MUV2.DE.thesis: Munich Re raised its 2026 profit target to EUR 6.6bn with Q3 results (9M net result EUR 5.7bn); the screen shows a rare leader in a weak tape: +4.2% 20d vs median -5.4%, 11.7% above SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 58.5, low 25.6% volatility. Rate-sensitive, non-tech earnings and EUR exposure suit a defensive regime; next results are not due until late February.

IBE.MC.thesis: Iberdrola grew 9M-2026 net profit ~10% to EUR 5.8bn on record investment and raised its 2026 outlook (targets a record year); screen shows a steady leader: +3.9% 20d, +13.7% 60d, 11.2% above SMA200, 3.7% off its 52w high, RSI 58, very low 16.4% volatility. Adds utilities/Spain exposure; FY results not due until late February.

PG.thesis: P&G's Nov 19 Investor Day laid out a ~USD 10bn productivity/savings plan; Citi raised its target to USD 190 and TD Cowen set USD 180 (vs 169.60 close). Screen: +6.1% 20d, +18% 60d, 12.8% above SMA200, 2% off its 52w high, RSI 61, low 19.1% volatility. Defensive US staple diversifies away from EU financials; next earnings late January.

BOCHGR.AT.thesis: Bank of Cyprus reported 9M-2026 profit of EUR 383m (+9%), RoTE 18.9%, and raised 2026 RoTE guidance to high-teens with a 70% payout plus up to 20% top-up. Screen 11-24: close 10.69, 2.7% off 52w high, +8.0% vs SMA200, above SMA50, RSI 51, volatility 26%, ADV EUR 6.2m. Adds Greek/Cypriot financials; next results with FY in February.

BELA.AT.thesis: Jumbo's Jan-Oct 2026 group sales rose 6.7% with October +13% (best month of the year, Greece +9% YTD); the EUR 1.00 special dividend already went ex on 16 Nov, so no distribution drop ahead. Screen 11-24: close 26.84, +9.6% vs SMA200, above SMA50, RSI 46, 6% off 52w high, very low 17% volatility, ADV EUR 8.6m. Defensive consumer name that diversifies away from banks.

AI.PA.thesis: Air Liquide is one of the few leaders in a weak tape: screen close 188.46, +8.2% 20d, +11.6% vs SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 62, lowest volatility in the shortlist (15.8%). Q3 showed +3% comparable growth and management is confident of +100bp margin in 2026; Kepler raised its target to EUR 223 (buy) on 19 Nov. Adds French industrial gases - non-tech, non-bank diversification; FY results not until around late February.

Anthropic listed on Nasdaq on 19 Nov 2026 at USD 83 and is one of the most actively traded US stocks; it has given back most of its first-day pop.
